# BTicino C300X Integration v2.1.4

## Unreleased

This release shows each page's name as the display heading and makes the
pages dialog explain itself.

The native agent stays at **2.1.2**; only the display files change and are
delivered through the agent-update Repair.

## Display

- A page's name is the display heading in place of Home Assistant; the status
  page keeps Home Assistant. The separate title line above the tiles is gone
  and leaves its room to the tiles.

## Pages Dialog

- Each section is titled with its page's name and says what it holds, every
  field has a short help text, and the step lists what name, position and
  entities do.
- A page's **Position** runs from 1 to 8, the first page being 1, in place of
  0 to 10000 in steps of 10. Pages with the same position keep the order of
  their sections.
- A page with entities needs a **Name**, since the display shows it as the
  heading; an older entry's untitled page asks for one when saved. Page names
  are unique regardless of capitalization.
- Besides the used pages, the first free section is open, so adding a page is
  visible; the other free sections stay collapsed.

## Upgrade

- The native agent stays at **2.1.2**. The new display files change the
  bundle hash, so the agent-update Repair offers them; it installs the display
  files alone, and the integration re-applies an active Display patch itself,
  which restarts the device GUI once.
- Home Assistant 2026.7 remains the minimum, and existing entries keep their
  pages.

## Validation

- The pages form is checked as Home Assistant serializes it for the frontend
  and walked through Home Assistant's flow manager. The display heading is
  covered by source contract tests only; it was not tried on a physical C300X.
